propositions: Blocking link events written before comparability became structural are durable and not re-resolved on read, causing epic-to-child and cousin edges to distort ready/next-batch and parent-first cascades
A store-wide scan must detect ancestor-blocking, mis-escalated, and unreadable blocking edges using the current resolver rather than replaying LINK/UNLINK events

Repair must write replacement links before removing stale ones to ensure interruption leaves a superset the next run converges, and must refuse ambiguous pairs carrying two net-active links for the same ordered pair
The --repair command refuses to run while a reconciler pass is in flight and holds no cross-item lock to avoid deadlock on the non-re-entrant tracker write lock
After repair, residual mis-escalated edges with closed source/blocked-side tickets are provably inert and cannot appear in ready/next-batch despite exit code 1
